Module dev.metaschema.core
Package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint

Class NoOpValidationEventListener

java.lang.Object
dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint.NoOpValidationEventListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
ValidationEventListener
public class NoOpValidationEventListener extends Object implements ValidationEventListener
A no-op implementation of ValidationEventListener that ignores all events.

This is the default listener used by ValidationConfig when no instrumentation is configured, ensuring zero overhead in the common case.
